**Japan's Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** for the period starting 2026-05-01. It ranks 32nd of 121 countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. At 1.91, Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population size alone would predict (1.0 is the global average).

A few other figures from the same record, next to the global average:
- **Use case:** 47% work vs. 43% globally, 47% personal vs. 40%, and 6% coursework vs. 16%.
- **How people use it:** 53% augmentation (working with Claude) vs. 51% globally, and 47% automation (handing tasks to Claude) vs. 49%.
- **Largest job category:** 23% of conversations matched Computer and Mathematical tasks, about the same as the global 24%.

These numbers describe observed Claude usage only, not jobs or the labor market. Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
